prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 3D editorial section illustration for a white website
Primary request: two tactile chunky open C-shaped pieces side by side, inviting a comparison between two approaches, equal footing.
Input images: Image1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only. Borrow its thick rounded forms, softly pebbled rubber surface, vibrant cobalt blue and sunny yellow. Do not repeat its interlocked composition or glow.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, isolated object group with generous clear transparent margins, no backdrop, no card, no floor plane.
Subject: exactly two separate chunky rounded open C pieces. Cobalt blue piece on the left, sunny yellow piece on the right. Equal physical scale and equal visual importance. Both rest upright with a small gap between them, slightly different orientations, neither touching nor interlocking, both fully visible.
Style/medium: polished restrained editorial 3D product rendering. Softly matte rubber, subtle fine pebbled tactile texture, pleasantly thick smooth curves and rounded ends, same family as Image1.
Composition/framing: square-ish frame, compact centered group occupying about 70 percent of the frame, generous transparent margins on every side. Consistent eye-level three-quarter camera, slight view from above. Keep the gap visibly open and both silhouettes readable at small website sizes.
Lighting/mood: soft professional studio illumination, soft surface highlights, only tiny controlled neutral contact shadows directly beneath the pieces. No colored aura, no glow.
Color palette: vibrant cobalt blue on left and warm sunny yellow on right, material colors matching Image1.
Constraints: true transparent background and clean alpha edges. No text, letters, numerals, logos, people, faces, robots, UI, background cards, scales, trophies, checkmarks, badges, winner cues or value judgement. No extra objects. The C forms are objects, not typography.
